one_liner_ko: AI용 오픈소스 검색 인프라(벡터·전문·정규식·메타데이터 검색 데이터베이스).
what_it_does_ko: Chroma는 벡터, 전문(full-text), 정규식, 메타데이터 검색을 지원하는 오픈소스 AI 데이터 인프라다. 임베딩과 메타데이터를 저장하고 밀집·희소·하이브리드 검색과 메타데이터 필터링, 텍스트·이미지 등 멀티모달 검색을 제공한다. 로컬 실행·셀프호스팅하거나, 객체 스토리지 기반의 서버리스 관리형 서비스인 Chroma Cloud를 쓸 수 있다. 엔터프라이즈용으로 BYOC(내 VPC), 멀티 리전 복제, 시점 복구를 제공한다.

evidence.quote: Chroma - open-source search infrastructure for AI
Fast, serverless, and scalable infrastructure supporting vector, full-text, regex, and metadata search. Built on object storage and trusted by millions of developers. Open-source Apache 2.0.
Chroma gives you everything you need for retrieval: store embeddings with metadata, search with dense and sparse vectors, filter by metadata, and retrieve across text, images, and more.
Run it locally, self-host, or use Chroma Cloud for a managed, serverless experience.
BYOC in your VPC, multi-cloud/multi-region replication, point-in-time-recovery ensure a resilient and scalable search system with the same 0-ops story as Cloud.
Semantic similarity search
Lexical search (BM25, SPLADE)
Trigram and regex search
Filtering and faceted search
Dataset versioning, A/B testing, and roll-outs
Index and search images, audio, and other modalities alongside text.
Command-line tools for development
Build agents that iteratively search and refine results for complex queries.
Index codebases to power coding agents using AST-aware chunking.
